header.title: Particles
header.description: Particle primitive shared by `ParticleBurst`, `ParticleRain` and `Rip`. `ParticleLayer` only draws and animates particles; the emitter owns the spawn physics (where they start, where they fly, how many). Use it to build your own effects.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: `kind` sets the look and `motion` the flight profile. With `emit` set to `click`, click the stage; with `always`, it emits every 160 ms.

code.click: on pointerdown, at the pointer position

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: The four built-in `kind` values: `confetti` (paper pieces), `spark` (thin glowing streaks), `star` (four-point sparkles) and `light` (soft orbs). All with `motion` set to `burst`. Click each one.

motions.title: Flight profiles
motions.description: `burst` and `rip` start at the pointer; `rain` falls from the top edge and clips anything that leaves the stage. Each profile changes the easing, end scale and keyframes.

rain.title: Continuous emission
rain.description: A `light` rain that emits every 160 ms. `useParticleField` with `maxLive` caps how many particles are on screen at once.

paused.title: Pause
paused.description: With `isPaused`, particles on screen freeze until their lifetime ends and the stage stops emitting. Click the stage and turn on pause while they fly.

custom.title: Custom particle
custom.description: `renderParticle` draws the content of each particle. The wrapper still flies with the same physics and gets its color in `particle.color`.

header.title: Particles API
header.description: Reference for `ParticleLayer`, `useParticleField`, the spawn helpers, CSS classes and variables, and the exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every `kind` and `motion`.

import.title: Import
import.description: Everything is imported from `@gem-org/gemffects/particles` and needs `particles.css` (already included in `styles.css`).

layer.description: Absolute layer that covers its positioned container and draws one particle per item in `particles`.

items.particles: Particles to draw. Pass the array returned by `useParticleField`.
items.motion: Flight profile: origin, easing, end scale and keyframes.
items.durationMs: Flight duration in milliseconds. When omitted, the CSS default applies (700 ms).
items.renderParticle: Custom content for each particle. Removes the `kind` background, shadow and clip.
items.style: Inline styles for the layer. Merged with `--gemfx-particle-duration`.

field.description: State for live particles. Each batch removes itself once its `lifetimeMs` ends.

options.maxLive: Maximum particles on screen. When there is no room, the batch is trimmed or skipped. When omitted, there is no cap.

result.spawn: Adds a batch and removes it after `lifetimeMs`. Use the flight duration plus a small margin.
result.clear: Removes every particle and cancels pending timers.
result.getLiveCount: Number of live particles, without triggering a render.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: Functions to build particles with the same sizes, spins and palettes the effects use.

items.createParticle: Builds a `Particle`. When `width`/`height`, `heading` or `spin` are omitted, they are derived from the `kind`.
items.resolveParticlePalette: Returns `colors` when set, otherwise `[color]`, otherwise the `kind` palette.
items.particleSize: Random size within the range of each `kind`.
items.particleHeading: Initial rotation. `spark` particles point toward their flight direction.
items.particleSpin: Random spin during the flight, per `kind`.
items.pickColor: Palette color for an index, cycling through the palette.
items.pickParticleKind: A random `kind` from the list (all of them by default).
items.PARTICLE_KINDS: The four built-in `kind` values, in order.
items.PALETTES: Default palette for each `kind`. They use `--gem-palette-*` tokens with a fallback color.

items.layer: Root layer: absolute, covers the container and ignores pointer events.
items.layerMotion: Active flight profile. `rain` also clips with `overflow: hidden`.
items.particle: Each particle. Positioned and animated with the variables below.
items.particleCustom: Added with `renderParticle`; removes background, shadow and clip.

items.easing: Flight curve. Each `motion` uses a `--gemfx-easing-*` token.
items.endScale: Scale at the end of the flight (`burst` 0.35, `rain` 0.55, `rip` 0.25).
items.originY: Vertical offset of the origin point, per `motion`.
items.offset: Distance the particle travels, in px.
items.rotation: Initial rotation and spin during the flight, in degrees.
items.size: Particle width and height, in px.
items.delay: Delay before the flight starts, in ms.

items.hidden: The layer is aria-hidden with pointer-events: none: it is decorative and never blocks interaction.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce particles are not animated and stay invisible, except inside .gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion.
items.emitter: When you build your own emitter, check prefersReducedMotion() (from @gem-org/gemffects/utils) so you don't spawn particles nobody will see.
items.control: Whatever triggers the emission must be a real control (a button with an accessible name) that also responds to the keyboard.
items.budget: Use maxLive to cap how many particles exist at once, especially with continuous emission.
